name: portfolio-os
tagline: Self-hosted operations app for teams managing portfolio sites
description: portfolio-os is a self-hosted operations app built for teams that manage multiple portfolio websites. It centralizes the operational side of running a portfolio — giving a small team a shared place to track, manage, and coordinate the sites they operate. Written in PHP, it fits the classic self-hosted LAMP-style stack and is aimed at keeping portfolio management organized without a heavyweight SaaS.
highlights: Self-hosted ops app for teams running portfolio sites
Centralizes management across multiple portfolio websites
Fits a classic PHP/LAMP self-hosted stack
A lightweight alternative to heavyweight SaaS
curatorNote: Most portfolio tooling focuses on building the site, not running it. A self-hosted ops layer for teams managing many portfolios is a niche but real need.
